name: Canvas Board: Infinite Whiteboard Suite
description: Infinite canvas & visual whiteboard plugin for EdgeEver: Native new note type integration in dropdown menu, draggable note cards, sticky notes, flowchart shapes, smart connectors, freehand doodles, and 100% offline auto-persistence.

zh-CN.name: Canvas Board: 无限白板与架构画布
zh-CN.description: 为 EdgeEver 带来原生的二维无限思维画布与架构白板。无缝集成至左侧边栏「更多类型 ▾」新建笔记菜单中，提供可缩放漫游的无限网格、富文本便签卡片、流程图形状、智能吸附连线、自由涂鸦以及一键导出高清图，数据 100% 离线静默自动保存至笔记。

author: zyhcs
